calibration_sources: TransformerEngine / Megatron-Core TP Overlap (Ring-Exchange vs Copy-Engine P2P_CUMEM & NVLS multimem)
GPU Wave Quantization Degradation Under Concurrent NCCL SM Stealing (132 SMs -> 108 SMs)

workload_baseline.node: 8x H100/H200 SXM5 (900 GB/s NVSwitch 3.0), TP=8 + Sequence Parallelism (SP)
workload_baseline.layer_shape: 8,192 tokens × 8,192 hidden dim (70B/405B Transformer block, 2 AG + 2 RS per pass)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Sequential TP+SP (Wait for Full AllGather -> Run GEMM -> Wait for Full ReduceScatter)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统串行 TP+SP (先等完整 AllGather 跑完 -> 算 GEMM -> 再等完整 ReduceScatter)
tiers.mechanism: Executes NCCL AllGather and ReduceScatter strictly sequentially before/after cuBLAS GEMMs on the same stream

tiers.name: Tier 2: Naive 2-Stream Chunked NCCL Overlap (4 Chunks + 24 NCCL SMs Stealing Compute Wavefronts -> GEMM Slowdown)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 粗放双流分块 NCCL 重叠 (切 4 块并发，但 NCCL 抢占 24 个 SM 导致矩阵乘掉速 -18.5%)
tiers.mechanism: Splits GEMM & NCCL into 4 chunks on 2 CUDA streams; NCCL kernels occupy 24 SMs & L2 bandwidth, starving cuBLAS wave quantization

tiers.name: Tier 3: PyTorch CUDASymmetricMemory + Cutlass Tile-Centric P2P Push/Pull (Fused Producer-Consumer Tile Ring)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: PyTorch CUDA 对称内存 (SymmetricMemory) + 瓦片级 P2P 原位直推 (消除独立通信核启动)
tiers.mechanism: Maps peer HBM into local virtual address space via cuMemMap; GEMM epilogue writes output tiles directly to peer HBM over NVLink

tiers.name: Tier 4: Zero-SM Hardware Copy-Engine DMA AllGather + NVLS multimem.ld_reduce Fused Epilogue (100% 132-SM GEMM)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 零 SM 硬件 Copy Engine DMA 预取 + NVSwitch multimem 硬件归约融合尾声 (132 个 SM 全力算矩阵乘)
tiers.mechanism: AllGather runs on 0-SM hardware Copy Engines (P2P_CUMEM); ReduceScatter fuses PTX multimem.red into GEMM epilogue via NVSwitch ALU

overlap_perturbation.condition: Short Sequence / Small Batch (2K Tokens, Latency-Bound)
overlap_perturbation.insight: Eliminates 16 separate NCCL kernel launch overheads per layer via fused multimem epilogue

overlap_perturbation.condition: Standard Pretraining Sequence (8K Tokens, Compute + BW Balanced)
overlap_perturbation.insight: Zero-SM Copy Engine preserves all 132 H100 SMs for cuBLAS tile wave quantization (99.2% GEMM retention)

overlap_perturbation.condition: Long Sequence FP8 Training (32K Tokens, Higher Comm-to-Compute Ratio)
overlap_perturbation.insight: FP8 doubles Tensor Core speed, making TP communication 38% of layer time unless hidden by Tier 4 Async-TP

overlap_perturbation.condition: Multi-Node TP=16 Across 2 Nodes (Cross-Node RoCE/IB Bottleneck)
overlap_perturbation.insight: 2D Hierarchical Async-TP overlaps inter-node RDMA chunk 0 while computing intra-node NVLink chunks 1..7
